premises.text: To get 2 10 HSM cases within 5 doublings we need each resident to infect (almost) 4 other residents.
The total infectivity rate at HSM is 4 times that elsewhere in Wuhan.
The Kashgar outbreak would be a relevant analog to the HSM outbreak if half a million people came to HSM in one day, and more people brought the illness to it than from it.
Saar claims that asymmetries in the contact graph cause outbreaks to be more likely to show up at HSM than expected
Some animals at HSM might later be infected by humans.
